rows.traditional: 搞到 A 大受打擊
rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A daai6 sau6 daa2 gik1
rows.note: Use this causative pattern when an event severely damages someone's morale or causes intense emotional distress.

example.english: Failing the exam can devastate him.
example.traditional: 呢次考試失敗搞到佢大受打擊。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 sat1 baai6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 daai6 sau6 daa2 gik1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for physically destroying buildings, places, or large areas.

example.english: A huge fire can devastate an entire industrial area.
example.traditional: 一場大火可以摧毀成個工業區。
example.jyutping: jat1 coeng4 daai6 fo2 ho2 ji5 ceoi1 wai2 seng4 go3 gung1 jip6 keoi1
